ios.desc:
The 7 Services app instantly connects you to trusted, local professionals: plumbers, electricians, builders, handymen, cleaners, caterers and more - all available on-demand through live video.

In just three taps, you’re face-to-face with a verified expert ready to assess your job. No searching profiles, no call-backs, no waiting around.

Discuss what you need, get a live quote, book a visit, and pay securely only after the job is done - all in one easy-to-use app.

Perfect for:

> Home repairs, maintenance and general handyman services
> Electrical, gas and plumbing work
> Property renovations and building jobs
> Cleaning and home catering

Key Features:

> Smart Matching - Instantly connects you with nearby professionals in real-time
> Live Video Call - Show the issue and get immediate advice or a quote
> Interactive Whiteboard - Draw, mark, and explain tasks visually
> Document & Photo Sharing - Share images, plans, or estimates with ease
> Secure Payments - Pay automatically and only when the job is complete
> Verified Experts - Every tradesperson is vetted for quality and reliability

quotes.text:
The Seven Services app allows clients to submit on-demand or scheduled requests to Service Providers for tasks to be completed remotely or in-person.

I wanted to build an Uber of tutoring and started with on-demand (in real-time) remote lessons on mobile devices. Recently, I decided to include Building and Domestic services. I envision "Seven Services" to one day be a super-app with which you can request a myriad of Services, delivered remotely or in-person.

You can try out the app (available on both App Stores) by sending a request and talking to one of our Professionals. Log in with username: yc@whizzkid.co and password: yc It's early days. Hopefully, someone will pick up. If they do, just let them know that you are trying out the app :-)
